name: flowtrace
description: Plan a change before any code, well enough to steer it, and explain one to someone who has never seen it. plan-flows reads the code the change touches, researches how it is best done, and draws the plan as a storyboard: every step in order, each with a picture, the gist, how it works and the trade-off made there; during the build the page shows each step's result beside what was promised. plan-check then questions the approved plan; explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after. In the Claude app, a hook holds a choice in the next-step box until its page is out.
